test_title: PYST 25: SSC JE ME - Reassoning (Held on: 14 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: City C is north of the mid-point of the horizontal line joining city A and city B. City A is to the north-east of city E and south-west of city C. If city D is to the east of city C and north of city B, then what is the position of city D with respect to city E?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: City C is north of the mid-point of the horizontal line joining city A and city B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/def33d9765feca3b3ea6f488949639dbd643fc82666bba7ed6d5ba221f5cb9d2.png] 

Step 2: City A is to the north-east of city E and south-west of city C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9eec0c66b59f0233cc5e054dd3748954b297d8f5120cf73037ace06d9e83d92.png] 

Step 3: If city D is to the east of city C and north of city B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9ec877313ff8b66cea690b31a5573a9ebf57a80b9347ea563c29d29de98e944.png] 

From the arrangement, we can see that **the position of city D with respect to city E is North-East.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "option (4)".**
